entities.summary: Danilo Petrović is a Serbian former professional tennis player. He achieved a career-high ATP singles ranking of world No. 137 on 19 October 2020 and a career-high doubles ranking of world No. 205 on 28 May 2018. Petrović won two singles and two doubles titles on the ATP Challenger Tour.
